title: Garmin Forerunner 255 Smart Watch Gray US$160.14 (~A$224.03) AU Stock Shipped @ Aussie Electron AliExpress
body:

[Clear] How does an every day person in China afford anything if Australian pricing was applied to everything?
[willyroo] Getting close to clearance for the 255. It's been superseded by the 265 and more recently the 570.
Awesome, awesome bit of kit. Has a lot of the features of the 9-series Forerunners, including native multisport (eg triathlon) activities. Its HR isn't perfect, however it's close enough to a chest strap HR that only the elite athletes will need the improvement.
And the battery just seems to last forever. I thought about charging this morning after my ride, and in the last 10 hours it's gone from 25% to 21%. Still a couple of days left before I need to worry about charging.

[MushyB] Bought this in the previous deal and have been wearing it for a week now. Watch is great. Light weight and comfortable. Button only navigation takes a bit of getting use to. More features than I care to use it for. I mainly just want to track my runs. So far, I have been pleased with the bang for buck. If it was truly an everyday wear, I I think the 265 is probably worth the upgrade. But for fitness tracking and access to the Garmin software and coaching, this is an easy recommendation.
Also got a tempered glass screen protector from amazon which has been good.
